bullets.text: Over 100 locations in Chennai including parts of Pattabiram will face a power cut on September 22, so the office should monitor affected areas.

stories.title: Chennai Power Cut On Sep 22: Over 100 Locations To Be Hit By Supply
stories.snippet: Chennai Power Cut On Sep 22: Over 100 Locations To Be Hit By Supply Over 100 locations will be hit by a power supply in Tamil Nadu capital Chennai on Tuesday. Parts of Ambattur, Kavanur, Pattabiram, Perumbakkam and…
